replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a statistical technique used to reduce the dimensionality of a dataset. It does this by transforming the original variables into a new set of uncorrelated variables called principal components. The first principal component is the direction in the data that has the largest variance. Each subsequent component is orthogonal to the previous ones and has the next largest variance. To perform PCA, you first need to standardize your data. Then, you compute the covariance matrix. Next, you compute the eigenvectors and eigenvalues of the covariance matrix.
